test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part.

You can be sentenced for __trespassing__ on someone else’s property.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Trespassing refers to **"entering without permission" **onto someone else’s property.
 
• The other options do not accurately convey the meaning of **trespassing**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"You can be sentenced for entering without permission on someone else’s property."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "leaving without permission" - Incorrect, as it refers to exiting, not entering a property.
 
• **Option 2:** "showing unselfish devotion" - Incorrect, as it does not relate to the concept of trespassing.
 
• **Option 4:** "conspiring against others" - Incorrect, as it means plotting against someone, which is unrelated to the physical act of trespassing.
